summary: Iter 27 — independently verified the three new feature areas end-to-end on the preview URL: (A) MERCHANT STOREFRONT BUILDER, (B) SELF-SERVICE COUPONS (incl. coupon-at-checkout math), and (C) TIERED DRIVER PAYOUT copy/regression. 15/15 backend pytest pass; merchant frontend (storefront editor + public hero + coupons CRUD UI) works; /driver/earnings shows Premium 100% + Standard 80% tiers with the $17.00 / $14.60 examples; /driver-onboarding shows both tier badges. No stale '10% on delivery' / '90%' / 'flat universal 100%' text found.
critical_code_review_comments: Storefront: PUT /api/merchant/storefront correctly enforces bio<=500 (400) and gallery<=6 (400); per-image base64 size cap also enforced at ~1MB (413). PUBLIC GET /api/merchants/{vendor_id}/storefront returns the doc without auth and (correctly) returns an empty default when no doc exists — frontend RestaurantMenu.js still renders the hero shell, with bio/logo/gallery from the customisation doc when set.

Coupons: POST /api/merchant/coupons validates discount_type (percentage|fixed), value>0, percentage<=100, regex ^[A-Z0-9]{3,20}$ on code, uniqueness per merchant; auto-generates an 8-char code when blank. PATCH/DELETE scope to vendor_id (other merchants' coupons → 404). LIST returns used_count + is_expired correctly.

Coupon-at-checkout (_apply_merchant_coupon): percentage 15% on subtotal 50 → discount 7.5, total 55.5 (50+10+0+3-7.5) ✓; fixed $5 → discount 5, total 58.0 ✓; wrong/other-store code → 404 ✓; min_order violation → 400 ✓; usage_limit (1) exceeded on a second different order → 400 ✓. Coupon uses the order's single discount slot (replaces platform promo) — by design.

Tiered payout regression: POST /api/orders/create returns service_fee=3.00 (100% platform), driver_fee_rate in {0.00, 0.20} (premium vs standard — never legacy 0.10), total = subtotal+delivery+tip+service_fee. Auto-assign + _finalize_driver_split path looks correct; full driver_earnings $21/$25 split is dependent on a driver being online (not exercised here — main agent already unit-verified).

Frontend storefront: /merchant/storefront editor mounts, bio textarea saves, public /restaurant/{id} hero shows the new bio (data-testid='storefront-hero-bio' populates as expected). /merchant/coupons creates coupon via generate+create flow, lists it with per-code toggle (data-testid='coupon-toggle-{CODE}') and delete (data-testid='coupon-delete-{CODE}') buttons.

Driver copy: DriverEarningsDashboard renders two tier cards 'Premium (Subscriber) 100% of every delivery fee + 100% of tips. No platform cut.' and 'Standard (No subscription) 80% of every delivery fee (20% platform cut) + 100% of tips.' Example calc card shows $17.00 (Premium) and $14.60 (Standard). DriverOnboarding badges read 'Premium: keep 100% of delivery fees', 'Standard: keep 80% of delivery fees', '100% of your tips, always'. No legacy 'up to 90%' or '10% on delivery' strings.
